full_prompt_en: A square surreal realist painting shows a solitary person standing on a grassy path above an immense sea of white clouds, looking toward a distant tower of sunlit cumulus. The figure is very small in the lower center, seen from behind in a long muted brown coat and dark trousers. Its head and hands are simplified by distance, while the body remains an upright, unmistakable human mark against the luminous background. A narrow beige path enters from the lower-left edge, curves gently past the person, and tapers toward the right side of the grassy ridge. The ridge itself is olive green with fine grain and a softly rounded edge. Beyond it, dense low cloud tops fill the middle of the frame like an endless pale surface, their small scalloped forms catching cream light. At the horizon, a massive cumulus formation rises in the center-left, built from rounded ivory and warm gray lobes that stack into a high sculptural mound. Smaller cloud banks stretch to both sides. Above them, a calm muted turquoise sky occupies the upper third and has almost no detail. No buildings or other travelers interrupt the view. Warm daylight appears to come from the upper left, brightening the cloud tower and open cloud sea; the figure and ridge remain comparatively subdued, with a short dark contact shadow falling to the right. The painting has smooth tonal transitions in the sky and a subtly stippled surface in the grass and clouds. The extraordinary landscape is presented with restrained, believable light rather than a dramatic effect. No readable writing is present. The overall composition balances a tiny contemplative human form against colossal pale clouds and open sky, using the curving path to suggest a quiet threshold between solid ground and boundless air.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超现实写实绘画描绘一位孤独的人站在巨大白色云海上方的草坡小路边，望向远处受阳光照亮的积云高塔。人物在下方中央十分渺小，从背面可见一件低调棕色长外套和深色裤子。距离使头和手简化，但身体仍是明亮背景前清楚的直立人形。狭窄米色小路从左下边缘进入，在人物身旁轻轻弯过，向草脊右侧逐渐收窄。草脊呈橄榄绿，带细颗粒与柔圆边缘。其外，密集的低层云顶像无边浅色表面般填满中部，小小扇贝状云形接住奶油色光。地平线上，巨大的积云在中央偏左升起，由圆润象牙色和暖灰色云瓣层叠成高耸雕塑般的云丘。较小云带向两边伸展。云上方，平静低调的青绿天空占据上方三分之一，几乎没有细节。没有建筑或其他旅人打断景象。暖日光似乎来自左上，照亮云塔和开阔云海；人物与草脊较为低调，一道短暗接地影向右落去。画面在天空里有平滑色调过渡，在草与云里有轻微点状表面。非凡风景以克制、可信的光线呈现，而非夸张效果。没有可读文字。整体构图以小小沉思的人形平衡巨大的浅色云层与开阔天空，弯曲小路暗示坚实地面与无边空气之间的安静门槛。
style_prompt_en: The image has a quiet surreal realist finish, with carefully graded atmosphere and subtle grain rather than emphatic brush marks. Muted turquoise, warm ivory, soft gray, and olive beige create a restricted airy palette. Broad smooth upper color gives way to finely scalloped pale middle texture and a narrow granular lower band. Gentle rounded edges make large masses feel buoyant, while one small dark vertical accent provides scale and focus. Warm upper-side daylight illuminates raised pale forms and leaves subdued near surfaces with a short contact shadow. A curving low line leads into vast horizontal negative space, making the composition contemplative and open. The overall effect is dreamlike yet materially calm, with enormous scale expressed through simplicity.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有安静的超现实写实完成面，依靠细致渐变的大气和轻微颗粒，而非强烈笔痕。低调青绿、暖象牙白、柔灰与橄榄米色形成有限而通透的调色。上方宽阔平滑色域转为中部细小扇贝状浅色肌理，再落到狭窄颗粒感下带。柔圆边缘使大形轻盈漂浮，一处小深色竖向强调提供尺度与焦点。暖色上侧方日光照亮凸起浅色形体，让低调近处表面带一道短接地影。一条低位弯曲线引入巨大的水平负空间，使构图沉思而开放。整体效果梦幻却有材料上的平静，宏大尺度通过简洁表达。
theme_en: A lone person on a grassy path above a sea of clouds
theme_zh: 独自站在云海之上草坡小径旁的人
name: Quint Buchholz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
